title: Discovery Engine: AssistAnswer Field Now Read-Only, New OAuth Auth Option
summary: A breaking change makes `connectorDisplayNames` in `AssistAnswer` read-only, requiring updates if you were writing to it. Additionally, a new `basicAuthenticationEnabled` field provides more flexibility for OAuth integrations.
details:
The `GoogleCloudDiscoveryengineV1alphaAssistAnswer` schema now marks the `connectorDisplayNames` property as `readOnly`. This is a breaking change; if your code attempts to write to this field, it will now fail. This field is intended as an output-only map from internal connector agent names to human-readable display names, populated by the service. Developers should update their implementations to no longer set this value.

Separately, the `GoogleCloudDiscoveryengineV1alphaAuthorizationServerSideOAuth2` schema gains a new `basicAuthenticationEnabled` boolean field. This allows you to configure HTTP Basic authentication (`client_secret_basic`) for OAuth token exchanges, useful for integrating with OAuth providers that require this method instead of the default `client_secret_post`.
